dispute.claim_text: I tried to cancel my subscription in August by emailing support, but I was charged again in September.

evidence.text: Cardholder to general support address: 'Please cancel my subscription.' No reply or confirmation on record.
Merchant cancellation terms: 'Cancellations must be submitted through the account dashboard at least 5 days before the renewal date. Email requests are not processed.'

labels.notes: Medium, sympathetic-but-weak. The cardholder attempted to cancel (ev_002) but not through the method the terms require and with no confirmation (ev_003), so there is no proof the cancellation validly took effect (r2 gap). The charge cannot be confidently shown invalid -> insufficient. Tests not overclaiming a win on a weak case.
